## Market-backed objective
Acquire and validate capability `technical_proposal` for real paid opportunities.

- Priority score: 84.46
- Referenced market value: 48935890.0
- Originating opportunity IDs: market-1c5c3f8454ca368d, market-8daa2976fca3a6ff, market-aac061eaabf9966a, market-f370f8671cccc7ed, market-fc8c54f62598663a, market-73c4fc10813d3a8b, market-1032b923f20b4bfe, market-5d09a5fd5f8a79e3, market-70e8c84d92f5bcc4, market-9872a3954e1ac924, market-014364b39b18351a, market-1daf71b2019383fc, market-2f275a827c6ca0f0, market-798bcda8c89e00c8, market-a9094f3bad7ca65f, market-b3de2d28ca5015ca, market-62f75a247dab9cc0, market-c75d6042202c6f69, market-08fe01cc924ebfe7, market-3e05a7c6e9ae7ad8, market-906a8a2acacc09e4, market-106b59a047e35450, market-c5f3b9168e15eb52, market-f03a6ebac9c36f6e, market-ffb9a9635591b718, market-3ff8d2cc071d0855, market-62f48f66c6d69241, market-afecaf51c21016a7
- Market evidence: https://github.com/antinomyhq/forge/issues/389

## Required interface
```json
{
  "input": "canonical opportunity dossier and source evidence",
  "output": "testable deliverable, validation evidence and execution receipt"
}
```

## Acceptance tests
- [ ] reject missing or unverified source evidence
- [ ] produce a deterministic or bounded artifact
- [ ] record hashes and test evidence
- [ ] fail closed on legal, account, identity, payment and scope gates
- [ ] pass a fixture based on the originating opportunity type

## Promotion and budget
- Promote only after unit tests and one dry-run artifact; never infer external submission or revenue.
- Use existing infrastructure first; any new paid dependency requires explicit approval.

## Mandatory continuation
Re-run universal market qualification after promotion.

No external submission, account creation, legal acceptance or revenue claim is authorized by this internal issue.

## Portfolio lane
`cash_first` — strategic work is limited while the first verified payment remains zero.
